# Nexera Sourcing & Exim

> Nexera Sourcing & Exim runs a personalised business delegation from India to the 140th Canton Fair (China Import and Export Fair) in Guangzhou, China, 15 October to 4 November 2026. The delegation includes a personalised sourcing itinerary, verified supplier meetings booked in advance, visa assistance, hotel, airport transfers, buyer badge registration and an interpreter. Packages start at Rs 85,000 per person (double sharing, 6 nights 7 days), plus 5% GST, 2% TCS and airfare, up to Rs 2,35,000 for an 18 night 19 day package.

Nexera Sourcing serves Indian business owners, importers, manufacturers, MSMEs, women entrepreneurs and startup founders travelling from India to China for the Canton Fair. It is not a general travel agency: the focus is on business outcomes (verified suppliers, factory meetings, sourcing costs) rather than tourism.

## Key facts

- Event: 140th China Import and Export Fair (Canton Fair), Guangzhou, China
- Dates: 15 October to 4 November 2026, in three phases (Phase 1: 15-19 Oct, electronics and machinery; Phase 2: 23-27 Oct, home and consumer goods; Phase 3: 31 Oct-4 Nov, textiles, health and personal care)
- Organiser: Nexera Sourcing & Exim, India
- Starting price: Rs 85,000 per person, double sharing, 6 nights 7 days, plus 5% GST + 2% TCS + airfare
- Package durations available: 6N/7D, 8N/9D, 10N/11D, 12N/13D, 18N/19D
- Contact: +91 7746 050190, +91 8823 050190, +91 8964 050190, nexerasourcing01@gmail.com
- Website: https://nexerasourcingandexim.com
